description: Receiving -> Prep (FBA units) | Pack (merchant-fulfilled units) -> Returns (if a return happened) -> Recovery. Returns and Recovery judge with upstream evidence, so resume re-runs them when that evidence or an override of it changed after they ran (D-012). Record every change in docs/decisions.md. Prep, Pack and Returns set needs_confirmed_product: when Receiving FAILs because the ordered product did not arrive (wrong item, no product visible, none counted), the workflow halts for a person before them (D-018).
